About the model

One glTF file, embedded in this page. The tour splits it by block position into rooms and moves each room on its own.

    Model: duo_base.glb from the Watchtower project. Block textures are the Minecraft textures baked into the file. Rendered with Three.js r147. Drag nothing: scroll, or use the stop markers.
